description: Simulated overdispersed counts (theta = 2) with an exposure offset: no instability, a planted split at z1 = 0.5, a theta-only change, and a school-clustered version. Integer case weights w.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 600L
    g <- 30L
    d <- data.frame(school = sample(seq_len(g), n, replace = TRUE), x = rnorm(n), z1 = runif(n), z2 = factor(sample(c("a", 
        "b", "c"), n, replace = TRUE)), z3 = rnorm(n), exposure = runif(n, 0.5, 2))
    u <- rnorm(g, 0, 0.5)[d$school]
    left <- d$z1 <= 0.5
    eta_null <- 0.5 + 0.5 * d$x
    eta_one <- ifelse(left, 0.2 + 0.8 * d$x, 1 - 0.3 * d$x)
    d$y_null <- rnbinom(n, mu = d$exposure * exp(eta_null), size = 2)
    d$y_one <- rnbinom(n, mu = d$exposure * exp(eta_one), size = 2)
    d$y_theta <- rnbinom(n, mu = d$exposure * exp(eta_null), size = ifelse(left, 0.7, 20))
    d$y_cluster <- rnbinom(n, mu = d$exposure * exp(u + eta_one), size = 2)
    d$w <- sample(1:3, n, replace = TRUE)
    d
}
